title: Building Brand Assets: The Role of Trademark Rights
eligible_reason: Nonlinear models (negative binomial for applications, Tobit for classes, probit for extension) and a separate 12-month pre/post window for each of seven Supreme Court rulings. The control group is the same trademark networks observed around rights-neutral rulings, so there is no unit-level staggered adoption and no untreated comparison units in a common panel. Estimates also include network age, size, class and TTAB controls.
design_notes: Equation 3: TM_ik = b0k + b1k (CHNG x SCD) + b2k (NEUTR x SCD) + B X_ik + Lambda + eps, where SCD = 0 for the 12 months before and 1 for the 12 months after a Supreme Court decision, estimated separately for each of seven cases (Two Pesos, Qualitex, Wal-Mart v. Samara, TrafFix, Moseley, KP Permanent Make-Up, Hana Financial). DiD estimate = b1k - b2k from Table 3 panels A-C (negative binomial, Tobit, probit). Table 4 (protected designs versus not) and Table 5 (single versus multiple brands) repeat the models for subgroups. Authors describe the control construction as akin to synthetic control and propensity matching.
estimators_reported: negative binomial / Tobit / probit DiD by Supreme Court case (Tables 3-5)
screener_notes: No replication package or regressions file was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Trademark data are drawn from the USPTO case files (public source) but no data-availability statement or replication archive is mentioned in the article. Not eligible under PROTOCOL Section 2: nonlinear models and per-event two-period designs.
